caption: The drawing depicts a single object consisting of a candle holder with a short, unlit, off-white candle. The candle holder has a round, brown base that appears to be made of wood. Rising vertically from the center of the base is a tightly coiled, brown metal spring forming the main body of the holder. The top of the spring supports a flat, circular, brown metal plate upon which the candle rests. Attached to the plate are two curved, brown metal arms extending outward, one curling downward and the other curling upward and outward. The background is plain and neutral, with no additional objects or features.
title: Candlestick
